integration_findings_fixed: Practice keeps rows in practice_records, but files, deadlines, events and Doc Tender reference matters/contacts/users by foreign key: practice now projects areas, counties, contacts, referral sources and matters into their section 5 tables in the same transaction (internal/practice/project.go).
Calendar ran on a process-memory store: it now has a Postgres store and migration 0500; deadlines survive a core restart (tested).

A Doc Tender job whose file an admin purged from the trash failed every pass (Drain returned not_found and the job retried forever); such jobs are no longer claimed or waited on (TestPurgedFileJobIsNeverClaimed fails before the fix).
The New Pleading form answered 200 for any matter id, walled or missing; it now checks the matter as the caller (regression test fails before the fix).
POST /api/v1/api-tokens filled owner_user_id with the caller even when module_id was given, so no module token could be issued.
A storage move started over the API ran on a goroutine that outlived App.Close; the core now cancels it on Close (a stopped move resumes at start).

A replacement core started by the supervisor during an update mounted only the secrets volume and would have started on an empty local-disk file store; Compose and the supervisor now mount core_data at /var/lib/togavsu-core, which the image creates for the non-root user.
Billing's receipt and invoice-PDF seams were nil in the core; files now open before finance and billing uses billing.FileLink.

Checkpoint (eaa2803): the ui compose layer (merged in ad298f5) built its own calendar on calendar.Memory and served calendar routes ahead of the core, so deadlines made on the composed site were lost on restart. compose.Mount now takes core.App.Calendar and sends every calendar route to the core handler; TestUICalendarIsCoreCalendar checks the Postgres row, the widget, the wall and a core restart, and fails on the old compose.go.

Checkpoint (eaa2803): the ui Postgres test helper called core.Open without DataDir, so on a non-root runner core.Open tried /var/lib/togavsu-core; it now passes DataDir: t.TempDir() (kept across the restart in the new test). internal/dashboard/compose passes inside test-core.sh as uid 1001.

observations: With Alpine's tesseract 5.3.4 on PATH (a stand-in tried first), TestDocumentsDocTenderCorpus failed at the 120-page scan: page 1's tesseract cross-check scored agreement 0.692, so the page went pending instead of passing. With the core image's tesseract 5.3.0 the case passes (case_doctender_tesseract), and without tesseract (Product CI's Core job) it passes. The synthetic scan's cross-check is therefore sensitive to the Tesseract build; the proposed CI change to add Ubuntu's tesseract-ocr (5.3.4 on ubuntu-latest) to the Core job should be landed only with that case watched, or use the core image's build. Not caused by this change (compose only).
